subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR, replace it with a maintainer-editable narrow PR, or close that candidate before repairing this cron stagger bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open closing fork PR already owns the GitHub link and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a duplicate until maintainers choose the handling path.

options.title: Open a credited replacement
options.body: Create a maintainer-editable narrow PR that preserves the useful linked-fork approach, credits the source work, and closes the uneditable candidate after the replacement exists.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR manually
options.body: A maintainer can review and land the existing fork PR if they are willing to handle its stale branch and CI state manually.

options.title: Close the candidate first
options.body: Close the open fork PR as not being the path forward, then let this issue become eligible for a fresh repair lane later.

recommendation.title: Open a credited replacement
recommendation.body: Create a maintainer-editable narrow PR that preserves the useful linked-fork approach, credits the source work, and closes the uneditable candidate after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The default-stagger behavior appears to originate in `steipete`'s cron stagger feature commit, making him the best routing candidate for the adoption-or-replacement choice.
